text:
maya-support: Heads-up: Enterprise customer AcmeRetail is hitting p95 latency spikes (~2-3s extra) + intermittent 401s since last night. They say canary traffic went to model 'opt-13b-quant-v2' (rolled 09:12 UTC). Also reported an unexpected billing jump for the /v1/generate route. Need req IDs, curl repros, and a debug bundle. @samir-eng can you triage? @luis-sre please scan routing/fallback logs.

samir-eng: Do we have any X-Request-IDs from the customer errors? even one sample will help correlate traces.

asha-cs: Pasting the one they gave: req-acme-20260724-17. They saw 3x 401s then a 502 on the same request id. Customer says it happens intermittently, ~1/200 requests.

maya-support: Asking them to run a quick reproducer — here's the sanitized curl they just ran (they removed keys):

```bash
curl -v \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -H "X-Request-ID: req-acme-20260724-17" \n  -d '{"model":"opt-13b-quant-v2","input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

luis-sre: Thanks. I see a deploy record for that time — deploy-bot, can you post the rollout table?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout: opt-13b-quant-v2 started 2026-07-24T09:12:04Z -> 20% traffic; health checks initially green; no automatic rollback.

luis-sre: From the routing logs I can already see a couple of entries for req-acme-20260724-17: backend responded 502 upstream read timeout, and a cluster of auth failures (401) that correspond to the same client session id. Possibly transient token validation failures + longer tail on KV cache misses for this model variant.

samir-eng: Can you paste the tiny trace snippet you grabbed? even a single log line.

luis-sre: log excerpt: 
`2026-07-24T09:13:02.423Z [req-acme-20260724-17] route=generate model=opt-13b-quant-v2 backend=runtime-12 status=502 err="upstream read timeout" kv_miss=true`
and
`2026-07-24T09:13:02.119Z [req-acme-20260724-17] auth=token-validate result=401 reason="jwt expired"`

asha-cs: Customer also attached a billing alert — they saw tokens consumed jump ~2x for generate during the same window. They think some requests retried and double-counted.

maya-support: Ok. Two parallel asks: (1) immediate mitigation — pin AcmeRetail to the stable variant to stop canary traffic for them, (2) collect repro artifacts (curl, debug bundle, trace + runtime logs) and a billing extract.

samir-eng: For mitigation, we can pin via the internal routing API. Example (internal only):

```bash
curl -X POST \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-internal-ADMIN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"org_id":"acme-retail","route":"/v1/generate","pin":{"model":"opt-13b-quant","version":"v1.2.3","force":true}}' \\
  https://console.redwood.ai/internal/routing/pin
```

samir-eng: I'll run that once ops confirms. Note: must include internal auth token and audit note.

luis-sre: Quick note on fallback: stable should have auto-fallback, but the canary variant missing the compatibility tag caused runtime to attempt optimized kernel paths that sometimes miss KV cache and extend latency — a regression. Fallback logic then hit 401s because the canary used a slightly different token validation path (edge case). We're treating that as a canary compatibility bug.

maya-support: Runtime team (runtime-bot / @runtime-bot) — can you pick this up? we need a repro test that hits the long-tail path (KV misses + token-refresh race) and a fix timeline.

runtime-bot: Picking up. Requesting: (A) collected debug bundle from customer (use https://support.redwood.ai/debug-upload), (B) the exact X-Request-IDs (they gave one), (C) a short curl reproducer with --include and --max-time so we can capture full response headers. Example repro command for the customer to run and attach: 

```bash
curl -i -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "X-Request-ID: req-acme-20260724-17" \\
  -d '{"model":"opt-13b-quant-v2","input":"trigger-kv-miss"}' \\
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate --max-time 30 > repro_resp.txt; tar czf debugbundle.tar.gz repro_resp.txt runtime-logs.txt; upload to support portal
```

asha-cs: I've told the customer to run that and attach the bundle. Also asked them to include their billing export CSV for the window 09:00-10:00 UTC.

luis-sre: After pinning to v1.2.3 we should see errors stop for them. If the customer saw double-counting, we need to check retry idempotency and billing instrumentation — open a billing ticket if consumption doesn't reconcile.

maya-support: Samir — please proceed with the pin and add an audit note referencing this thread. Also set a temporary rule to route AcmeRetail traffic to stable until runtime confirms fix.

samir-eng: Doing it now. Patch applied and verified: AcmeRetail -> opt-13b-quant@v1.2.3 forced. I also flipped their route to "force-stable" in routing config. Confirming in console: traffic for org acme-retail ~0% to canary.

asha-cs: Customer confirmed reduced errors within 8 minutes and billing stopped spiking. They appreciate the quick action. :thumbsup:

luis-sre: Next steps: runtime to provide a short postmortem (canary gating bug) and billing to reconcile any overage. Runtime, plz add fix PR link and rollout plan here when available.

runtime-bot: Will do — reproducer received, triage in progress. ETA for patch: 48 hours, will include a canary rollback guard and better compatibility tags for optimized kernels.

maya-support: Closing the customer loop, will follow up with written summary and attach debug bundle when it arrives. Thanks all.

samir-eng: marking thread resolved for support.

maya-support: resolved.
